item: The Merge shows the unreadable repair-record warning; the repaired-row wording says any newer attempt makes it measured, and a test pins that limit (diagnostics rank 14, the coordinator's post-merge check of #1299)
status: SHIPPED (field effect at the next Merge)
key_paths: src/api/diagnostics/qualification_merge.py; src/catalog/qualification_merge.py; src/static/app-ai-tools.js; src/catalog/qualification_export.py; src/catalog/qualification_integrity.py; docs/product/RELEASE_0.4_GATE.md; tests/test_qualification_merge_action.py; tests/test_curated_catalog_stamp.py
summary: The Merge fed this instance in as verdict rows only, so the rows an unreadable boot-repair run withdrew counted as measured corroboration with nothing said. The report's inputs now carry repair_record_unreadable (and the run ids) for this instance and for an uploaded export JSON, and the Merge panel writes the warning beside the numbers (one string, 12 locales); the merge still runs and refuses nothing. An all-diagnostics bundle, an export's YAML and the command-line merge do not carry it (stated in OPEN_QUEUE). The integrity docstring, the export comment, the basis block comment and the 0.4 gate now say any newer judging attempt, an imported one included, makes a repaired row measured, and a KNOWN LIMIT test pins it so that closing the gap is a visible change. Each fix has a test that fails when it is removed.
